name: Bauernhof Pixerhof
beschreibung: The farm Bauernhof Pixerhof is situated in the municipality of Bad Häring in the Tyrolean Unterland. The property combines active farming with an authentic inn establishment. The inn serves mouthwatering regional delicacies, many of which stem directly from the farm's own production. Guests can choose from several comfortable guest rooms and holiday apartments. Located at the peaceful edge of town, it affords a tranquil stay coupled with glorious panoramic mountain vistas. Popular excursion destinations such as Lake Hintersteiner See or the Fortress of Kufstein are conveniently within reach.
